name: Google Skills
summary: Google's learning platform for AI and cloud skills: free starter courses, badges and certifications, plus a $29/month Pro plan.
description: A training platform for Google Cloud and AI skills, with a catalog of courses, learning paths, hands-on labs, skill badges and certifications (kickstart certificates, skill badges, professional certifications). Topics include AI, Vertex AI, AutoML, prompt design, Gemini and DeepMind. Starter is free — 35 credits a month, limited hands-on labs and badges across all levels — while Pro unlocks thousands of courses and unlimited labs for $29/month, with 7-day trials for new subscribers.
